newsitem.title: USA: Multi-Market Radio buys Hartford station.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Market Radio buys Hartford station.

text.p: Multi-Market Radio Inc said it had acquired radio station WKSS-FM which serves the Hartford, Conn., market from Precision Media Corp for $18 million.

The company said in a statement late on Wednesday that upon completion of the merger between Multi-Market Radio and SFX Broadcasting Inc WKSS will become part of a cluster of stations serving the Hartford market.

Michael G. Ferrel, president and chief executive, said, "We are very excited to have gained WKSS which when combined with the Hartford stations that SFX now owns will create a highly desirable cluster of stations."
Hartford is the 41st largest metro market in the United States.
